detail: Acquisition - Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is hereby informed that IndiaMART InterMESH Limited (hereinafter referred as  Company ) has entered into an agreement to subscribe to 4,630 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) of Fleetx Technologies Private Limited (hereinafter referred as  Fleetx )
